title: Inlet/Storm Drain Stopped Up - Hazardous
description: Use this service request to report an inlet/storm drain that is stopped up and creating hazardous condition. The estimated response time for this service request is 1 business day.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 about a hazardous stopped-up inlet or storm drain.
actions.why: For an inlet or storm drain that is stopped up and creating a hazardous condition. The description for "Inlet/Storm Drain Stopped Up - Hazardous" requests on the Dallas 311 website and its instructions direct people to call 311.
